project_name: Eagle Rock Partners Colleton County Data Center Campus
aliases: Colleton County Cooks Hill Road data center campus
developer: Eagle Rock Partners; Thomas & Hutton; Weyerhaeuser Company
status_detail: Special Exception Case SE-2025-139 sought approval for an approximately 859-acre data center campus at 0 Cooks Hill Road; county materials show data centers added as a conditional/special exception use, while later county ordinance materials show a temporary moratorium on data center approvals.
notes: Official ZBA agenda names Thomas & Hutton and Eagle Rock Partners as applicant on behalf of Weyerhaeuser and describes 859 acres at 0 Cooks Hill Road. Local news reports nine proposed data center buildings and public opposition; no developer MW was confirmed in official county documents found.

project_name: Google Pine Hill Business Campus data center
status_detail: Google broke ground on two Dorchester County data center campuses in 2024; the Ridgeville facility is in Pine Hill Business Campus and county EDA later described the projects as under active construction.
notes: State and Dorchester EDA releases identify Pine Hill Business Campus in Ridgeville as one of two Google data center campuses. The two Dorchester campuses represented a $2B investment and 200 operational jobs in the 2024 announcement; 2025 county EDA material says Google's additional Dorchester investment builds on those projects.

aliases: DC BLOX Tier III Regional Data Center Greenville
status_detail: DC BLOX announced/started construction in Greenville County in 2020; later company release states the Greenville data center is open for business. Full build-out described as six data halls, 54,000 sq ft of data center space, and 18 MW critical load.
notes: Greenville County FILOT document identifies DC BLOX as Project Fiber for a new data processing facility; GADC and DC BLOX provide project details. Investment by DC BLOX and tenants was expected to exceed $200M.
